detail.longDescription: Back when I was scrolling through my first website in the mid-'90s—I'm almost certain it was SpaceJam.com—web forms were still in their nascent stage. Websites were treated more as one-way communication devices, like newspapers. Forms changed all that. At first, forms were clunky HTML elements that you had to pinch-and-zoom to interact with on small screens.
